messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Doses above 2 mg/kg have not been studied.
Doses above 200 mg a day have not been studied.
Extended-release metoprolol has not been studied in children under 6 years.
Dose adjustments:
Liver problems.
Start at a lower dose than usual and increase slowly.
Kidney problems.
No dose reduction is needed.
Older adults.
A low starting dose is generally used.
This is because liver, kidney, and heart function are more often reduced.
Other medicines are more often involved.
Switching between forms.
When changing from immediate-release to extended-release metoprolol, the same total daily dose is used.
Triplet: ["Metoprolol", "has unstudied dose", "above 2 mg/kg"]

The relation 'has unstudied dose' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has not been studied at the dose specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has no interaction with': The subject drug does not have a known pharmacological interaction with the object entity.
B. 'has unknown effect on': The effect of the subject drug on the entity specified by the object entity is not known.
C. 'not used for': The subject drug is not indicated or used for the condition, situation, or purpose specified by the object entity.
D. 'not chemically related to': The subject drug is not chemically similar to or related to the substance specified by the object entity.
E. 'does not show up on': The subject drug is not typically detected by the type of test specified by the object entity.
